name: Serpent Ward is tracked on the Witch Doctor's totem bar and can be dismissed there (#10802)
contract: Serpent Ward 500960 is Effect0 SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON of creature 50105 with EffectMiscValueB 63 in Spell.dbc, a
SummonProperties row with Type SUMMON_TYPE_TOTEM and Slot 1 (Fire); the other wards (63), effigies (81), idols (82)
and the Spirit Link Idol (83) use the other totem slots. The Witch Doctor spell corrections rewrite every summon

while only one ward stays out, and CMSG_TOTEM_DESTROYED (opcode 1044) for slot 0 dismisses it. The ward stays a
